# illumio-cloudsecure_policy_provision (Resource)

Provisions a policy version on CloudSecure, making it active. Only one version can be provisioned per policy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_version_id` (String) ID of the policy version to provision.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) CloudSecure ID.
